text: はじめに　ベトベター　だして…　いいや　ほかので　いっきに…　…　うーん　ブツ　ブツ…

structure.jp: はじめに　ベトベター　だして…
ほかので　いっきに…
structure.en: all at once with another one...

structure.jp: …　うーん　ブツ　ブツ…

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form leaves the sentence open, as in 'do this and then...'. ベトベター だして = 'send out Grimer and...'

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の here stands in for a thing already known, like 'one' in English. ほかの = 'another one'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で shows what is used to do something. ほかので = 'with another one'.
